name: QUT Guild Food Bank
summary: Free groceries for QUT students facing financial hardship, once a week at Kelvin Grove.
who: All QUT students facing financial hardship.
how: Arrive at 10 AM or earlier. No appointment needed.
catches: QUT Kelvin Grove, C Block, Level 4, C406. Open Tuesday to Thursday, 10 AM to 2 PM, unless capacity is reached.

evidence.quote: QUT Guild Food Bank is available to all QUT students to help you get through till your next payday.
Students are limited to one visit per week.
